tx_current_margin.scope: One hypothetical zero-mean supply-current perturbation at a time at the shared local-supply/quiet-return port, atop the caller-provided activity bounds. The 28 mA search cap and 7 mA probe are explicit sensitivity inputs, not an allocated TX bias or a transistor peak-current rating. When called from the RX ADC screen this is an added disturbance, not simultaneous selected TX/RX operation. Includes +/-1% board voltage and arbitrary relative origins of retained baseline groups. 35 mV threshold, 0.6 V input-leg enclosure, shared supply-delay sensitivity and pole. Sufficient voltage/edge conditions only, not jitter/EVM/emissions acceptance. Frequency samples are not a continuum bound; simultaneous tones, reference recharge, switching steps, physical isolation and nonlinear response require a joined waveform test. Zero allowance may mean an already-inconclusive baseline, not physical impossibility.

adc_activity.scope: Missing ADC gate/comparator/acquisition/reset supply activity hypotheses. Equal charge per 22 paired-I/Q events using the existing SAR schedule, 128 gamma-pulse harmonics; mean replaces steady ADC current at the lumped CORE/CONV network node. Constant-mean low-rate controls intentionally increase charge per conversion; fixed-charge rows keep energy-per-conversion scaling at fixed supply. Neither law is measured. The current ADC pair allocation limits switching activity; all other CORE/CONV owners remain reserved, including DAC and reference current. Existing 20 mA core pulses remain an explicit activity hypothesis. Independent ADC origin added to existing arbitrary-phase rail enclosure including board tolerance. Not fitted transistor current, code-dependent charge, startup or noise; reference recharge AC is not added here. Clock bounds add ADC harmonic magnitudes to existing independent-source bounds, with shared supply-delay sensitivity and pole. Thresholds are 20 mV legacy and 35 mV worst positive candidate-offset corner. Edge displacement is a deterministic enclosure, not RMS jitter or RF phase-noise qualification. Pulse truncation and waveform shape remain uncertainties.

scope: Finite-tone linear-network bounds for any D2H/H2D/timing/core origins with fixed selected current spectra. Includes differential source return. Shared incremental per-leg screen; failed bound does not demonstrate violation. Timing uses sufficient amplitude/derivative inequalities, shared threshold and single-pole supply delay. No payload, random noise, SAR feedback, frequency drift or different activity spectra, physical bias or lifecycle qualification.
